REQ-KTL-001.title: Boil water
REQ-KTL-001.statement: Pressing Start heats water until it boils.
REQ-KTL-001.acceptance: From 20 °C, 1.0 L reaches 100 °C within 240 s at 230 V.

REQ-KTL-002.title: Auto shut-off at boil
REQ-KTL-002.statement: Heating stops automatically when water boils.
REQ-KTL-002.acceptance: Heater de-energizes within 5 s of water reaching 100 °C.

REQ-KTL-003.title: Boil-dry protection
REQ-KTL-003.statement: The kettle never heats with no water.
REQ-KTL-003.acceptance: With an empty vessel, heater de-energizes before the element exceeds 140 °C.

REQ-KTL-004.title: Keep-warm
REQ-KTL-004.statement: After boiling, water can be held warm.
REQ-KTL-004.acceptance: With keep-warm on, water stays at 80 ± 5 °C for 30 min, then heating stops.

REQ-KTL-005.title: Child lock
REQ-KTL-005.acceptance: While child lock is on, Start presses are ignored; unlocking needs a 3 s hold.
